description: Delete a Batch job with all its runs and results, for good. A run in flight stops picking up tasks at once, and the job frees its active-job slot. The job reads as not found right away; storage is cleaned up in the background. Idempotent. To keep the results, use batch_cancel instead.

job_id.description: Batch job id returned by batch_create or batch_list

name: batch_delete
